title: Draft: Stock workspace and expandable on-hand balances
head: feature/stock-workspace-demo
body:
The Stock landing page now has grouped workspace navigation, server-backed summaries and filters, an expandable per-batch/location On-hand list, and helpful-information panels. Existing operations and reference forms stay mounted to preserve drafts; existing data, permissions and report actions are retained.

Draft preservation only: the owner requested a hold on new work and publication of existing changes for handover. **Not merge-ready.** Six old source-pinned assertion groups remain unchanged and failing; their exact UNAPPLIED proposal is in `docs/teams/inventory/handover-stock-workspace/`. Independent review also found remaining desktop targets below36px (help32, location24, info summaries28); no implementation fix was made after the hold. Other demo tabs/workflows remain incomplete.

Carried local validation: five new Vue runtime tests, full types/build and scoped lint/format pass; actual synthetic390/1440 light/dark checks cover held/expired stock, expansion, server search, loading parity, report dialog/focus, preserved drafts and Finance read-only visibility. Full frontend discovery2203 tests:2196pass, six affected assertion failures plus a PHP PATH-only failure whose5-test file passes separately. No fresh full backend suite or exact-commit CI claim. No schema/grants/backend changes and no production data.

Base c1e5fc05c0d231a28eeb3f2367ccc8adee0565c5. Validation artifacts: `/workspace/kpone-validation/stock-workspace/REVIEW.md`, screenshots/results in its `browser/` directory. No merge authorized.
